name: Document production index and summaries
summary: From a production review counsel has cleared, the paralegal prepares a draft for that counsel: an index of every document by Bates range, a short summary of each, every statement cited to its Bates page, missing documents and differing passages listed, and anything matching counsel's screen list held by number only.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for legal preparation work: a draft headed for a named lawyer, quotation and location in place of characterisation, the organisation's own documents and rules as the only inputs, and nothing sent or filed.

sources.contribution: One entry per produced document with its production number, date, author, recipients, type, a brief account and quotations located by Bates page; an opening count of the production and its date span; a Bates page behind each statement; material that may be privileged kept out of the summary for the lawyer; confidentiality markings noted; doubtful or clashing passages left as they stand; links between documents; and a list of documents mentioned but absent.
A longer description of the same method in the same repository, read for context. Every idea used here also appears in the file credited above.
